notes.title: Coin Collab
notes.content: There is a new Coin available in the game RIGHT NOW, created in conjunction with Coin! This item will only be available for 2 WEEKS. Hurry up!)

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
-changed banana inventory scroll speed from 1 to 200 on mouse wheel
-changed banana inventory from unconsildated to consolidated
-changed effect mask to match the banana for (doubanana, corn, potato, cabbage and coin)

notes.title: In-Game Event: Pantry Raid 1!
notes.content: Common bananas have been replaced with potatoes, corn cobs and heads of cabbage for a limited time.

notes.title: Community Update July 10th 2024
notes.content:
-added new artwork for drops
-added banana fairy for future update
-changed clicks per second to ~50ms

notes.title: Hotfix July 8th 2024
notes.content:
-fix buy banana popup
-fix buy banana success sound

notes.title: Community Update 4
notes.content:
-added exact time remaining until next drop
-added pop-ups telling you what bananas you got when buying, on afk drop and crafting.
-added crafting success pop-up
-changed info overlay to contain correct information for new update
-fixed ui overlay issues causing some buttons to be unpressable on window size change

notes.title: Community Update 3 - AFK Bananas
notes.content:
*SIGH* A lot of reviewers have been having a surprisingly difficult time understanding how to use the in-game currency to buy the banana bunches and that this particular clicker game requires actual clicking.

I have now removed the requirement for clicking to get the 2 hour afk bananas despite my preference.

notes.title: Yet another crafting update
notes.content: -fixed effects bananas being used as cauldron combination items

notes.title: Community Update July 7th 2024 - Crafting!
notes.content:
-added crafting area (3* same color banana = 1* random color banana with chance of getting an effect + 50 points)
-added X in top right of the change banana screen so you don't have to change bananas
-changed default sort order of inventory items from none to color then type
-fixed small click area on fullscreen
-some other quality of life stuff I forget

notes.title: Community Update July 5
notes.content:
-Changed: auto bunch drops in 2 hours instead of 3
-Changed: Buy bunch cooldown decreased to 1 minute instead of 2
-Changed: Window to be resizable
-Added: New anti-cheat measures and rate limiting, users triggering this will get a free image made by our community.

notes.title: Launch Day DDOS
notes.content:
Sorry if you wanted to play the game. It was targeted by "BananaFuckTeam". I'll be bringing the server back online soon. Here's just a few people from the BananaFuckTeam:
REMOVED
REMOVED
REMOVED

Honestly, -rep fr

They're upset that I deleted their inventory after they epxloited items into the game during beta and they have a lot more free time than me since I have a life. The future will probably be pretty rocky game-wise but hey, that kinda makes the bananas that exist more valuable.

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
-fixed a softlock when attempting to buy bunches without enough points
-changed when you are unable to reach the server (being offline), your points are not reduced.
